name: Kafka Studio
description: Operate Apache Kafka from one workspace: inspect topics and partitions, produce and consume messages, filter and decode payloads, monitor consumer lag, manage offsets and ACLs, stream records, and export results.
releaseNotes: 修复工作台状态在真机上不持久化的问题：DBX 沙箱 iframe 的 opaque origin 下 localStorage 直接抛错，原持久化静默失效；现在统一经 pluginStorage 适配器接入宿主 window.dbxPlugin.storage（Host API 1.2，capabilities.storage 探测，降级链：宿主桥 → 受控 localStorage → 内存，旧键一次性搬家），消息查询表单、树宽/折叠、内部 topic 显示、收藏 topic 与时区设置刷新后均保留。同步完成依赖升级：后端 twmb/franz-go 1.22.0、golang.org/x/net 0.59.0 等，前端 vue 3.5.43、ag-grid-community 36.2.0 等，工具链基线提升至 Go 1.26。Fixed workbench state not persisting on the desktop host: localStorage throws under the sandbox iframe's opaque origin, so the previous persistence silently failed; state now goes through a pluginStorage adapter backed by the host window.dbxPlugin.storage bridge (Host API 1.2, capabilities.storage detection, with guarded localStorage and in-memory fallbacks and one-shot legacy-key migration), keeping the messages form, tree width/collapse, internal-topic visibility, favorite topics and timezone across reloads. Dependencies were upgraded in lockstep: twmb/franz-go 1.22.0 and golang.org/x/net 0.59.0 on the backend, vue 3.5.43 and ag-grid-community 36.2.0 on the frontend, with the toolchain floor raised to Go 1.26.
